meta.era: No Man's Sky Wiki on Miraheze. Mineral ratios from the v1 refine list. The later refine and inventory craft rows follow the moodboard edge list. Crafted trade goods are the NMS-Handbook crafting table, commit 142d9ffd8078944722243398202f22cbef47cd02, 2026-02-20.
meta.disclaimer: Charging a technology is fuel. It is not a refiner recipe and it is not a craft row. Craft rows are made in station inventory. Wiring loom is bought, not crafted, so it has no edge. High-speed sublimation is the three-slot path to nitrogen salt, enriched carbon, and thermic condensate. Those three also have an inventory blueprint from the crafting table. Other three-input large-refiner rows, including alloy latticing, are left out. Silver and gold are gathered inputs. Platinum stays out. A later patch can change a recipe.
meta.omitted: Wiring loom. Portable refiner and starship launch fuel. Platinum. Cooking. Large-refiner recipes other than high-speed sublimation, including three-input alloy latticing. Repair Kit has an empty crafting-table ingredient list.

meta.tradeGoods: Inventory blueprints for crafted trade goods are copied from the NMS-Handbook crafting table, commit 142d9ffd8078944722243398202f22cbef47cd02, 2026-02-20 (Remnant 6.2 line). Stasis Device, Quantum Processor, and Cryogenic Chamber match the Miraheze craft boxes. The raw bill uses the inventory blueprint, then the one-way refiner ladders (condensed carbon to carbon, ionised cobalt to cobalt, pure ferrite to ferrite dust, and the other primary ladders). Base value is the product table BaseValue.
craftGaps: Starship Launch Fuel (LAUNCHFUEL) has a crafting-table recipe (40 Di-hydrogen and 1 Metal Plating) and stays out of the graph.
Repair Kit (REPAIRKIT) is in the crafting table with an empty Ingredients list, so it has no recipe.
Frigate Fuel (50 Tonnes), Frigate Fuel (200 Tonnes), and Surge Battery are WikiCategory NotEnabled in this extract.
Platinum is not an ingredient of these inventory blueprints. The three-input refiner alloy-latticing rows (tritium, silver, gold, or platinum) stay out.
Gamma Weed is the plant that yields Gamma Root. The recipes use Gamma Root.
Marrow Bulb and Sac Venom are not ingredients of these crafting-table recipes. Sac Venom has no crafting recipe.

nodes.name: Ferrite Dust
nodes.blurb: Common rock mineral. The bottom of the ferrite ladder.

nodes.name: Pure Ferrite
nodes.blurb: Refined ferrite. Dust steps up one-for-one. Magnetised ferrite breaks back into two.

nodes.name: Magnetised Ferrite
nodes.blurb: Top of the portable ferrite line. Carbon or a stellar metal pushes dust and pure ferrite here faster.

nodes.name: Rusted Metal
nodes.blurb: Junk from damaged containers. One unit breaks into two ferrite dust. Oxygen rusts ferrite back into it.

nodes.name: Carbon
nodes.blurb: Mined from plants, or burnt from oxygen at a loss. Two units condense into one.

nodes.name: Condensed Carbon
nodes.blurb: Denser carbon. One unit releases two carbon. Oxygen multiplies a stack.

nodes.name: Sodium
nodes.blurb: Yellow crystals. Two make one sodium nitrate. Oxygen and carbon also catalyse it.

nodes.name: Sodium Nitrate
nodes.blurb: The charged form of sodium. One unit frees two sodium. Oxygen doubles a stack, one for one.

nodes.name: Oxygen
nodes.blurb: Kept because the mineral loops use it. Burning it for carbon is a refiner recipe, not the same as charging life support.

nodes.name: Cobalt
nodes.blurb: Cave mineral. Two ionise into one. Oxygen is the multiplier.

nodes.name: Ionised Cobalt
nodes.blurb: Charged cobalt. One unit returns two cobalt. With oxygen, one becomes six.

nodes.name: Copper
nodes.blurb: Yellow-star stellar metal. Two units make one chromatic metal.

nodes.name: Cadmium
nodes.blurb: Red-star stellar metal. Two units make one chromatic metal. Ferrite fusion pays two.

nodes.name: Emeril
nodes.blurb: Green-star stellar metal. Two units make three chromatic metal.

nodes.name: Indium
nodes.blurb: Blue-star stellar metal. Two units make four chromatic metal.

nodes.name: Chromatic Metal
nodes.blurb: The alloy the stellar metals refine into. One unit plus one stellar metal returns two of that metal.

nodes.name: Paraffinium
nodes.blurb: Lush-world mineral. In this set it feeds ferrite dust, and star bulb trades with it.

nodes.name: Salt
nodes.blurb: Aquatic mineral. Two units concentrate into chlorine. Di-hydrogen and oxygen can form it.

nodes.name: Chlorine
nodes.blurb: Concentrated salt. One unit frees two salt. Oxygen multiplies a stack, the way it does for cobalt.

nodes.name: Di-hydrogen
nodes.blurb: Blue crystals. Forty craft a jelly. A refiner condenses thirty, then breaks that jelly back into forty.

nodes.name: Di-hydrogen Jelly
nodes.blurb: Condensed di-hydrogen. The blueprint takes forty. The refiner condenses thirty, and cycling returns forty.

nodes.name: Tritium
nodes.blurb: Asteroid fuel. Five units refine into one di-hydrogen. In this set it does not make platinum.

nodes.name: Nitrogen
nodes.blurb: Lush-world atmosphere. Three units transfer into one sulphurine. Oxygen or chromatic metal moves it one for one.

nodes.name: Sulphurine
nodes.blurb: Hot-world atmosphere. It sits between nitrogen and radon in the gas transfer cycle.

nodes.name: Radon
nodes.blurb: Frozen and radioactive atmospheres. Three units transfer into one nitrogen, closing the gas cycle.

nodes.name: Metal Plating
nodes.blurb: The first crafted sheet. Fifty ferrite dust. It goes into the portable refiner and launch fuel.

nodes.name: Hermetic Seal
nodes.blurb: A carbon seal. Thirty condensed carbon. Early ship repairs ask for it.

nodes.name: Carbon Nanotubes
nodes.blurb: Fifty carbon, drawn into a conductor. The microprocessor takes one.

nodes.name: Microprocessor
nodes.blurb: Forty chromatic metal and one nanotube bundle. A landing pad later asks for two.

nodes.name: Antimatter Housing
nodes.blurb: The casing for a warp cell. Thirty oxygen and fifty ferrite dust.

nodes.name: Antimatter
nodes.blurb: Twenty-five chromatic metal and twenty condensed carbon. Pair it with a housing.

nodes.name: Ion Battery
nodes.blurb: Five ferrite dust and ten cobalt. Charges hazard protection. The three-input refiner row is left out.

nodes.name: Life Support Gel
nodes.blurb: One di-hydrogen jelly and twenty carbon. A full life-support charge. Not the same as feeding oxygen into the suit.

nodes.name: Warp Cell
nodes.blurb: One antimatter housing and one antimatter. One cell, one jump. The large-refiner bypass is left out.

nodes.name: Cactus Flesh
nodes.blurb: Desert crop. With salt it titrates to pyrite, and it is half of poly fibre.

nodes.name: Fungal Mould
nodes.blurb: Toxic-biome crop. With salt it titrates to ammonia.

nodes.name: Gamma Root
nodes.blurb: Irradiated crop. With salt it titrates to uranium. Harvest wants a haz-mat gauntlet. Lubricant takes a large stack.

nodes.name: Solanium
nodes.blurb: Scorched crop, from solar vine. With salt it titrates to phosphorus. A heat capacitor takes a large stack.

nodes.name: Star Bulb
nodes.blurb: Lush crop. With salt it titrates to paraffinium. Poly fibre takes a large stack.

nodes.name: Frost Crystal
nodes.blurb: Frozen crop, from frostwort. Forty polish into glass. With dioxite the stock expands. With salt it titrates to dioxite.

nodes.name: Kelp Sac
nodes.blurb: Water plant. With oxygen it yields bonded chlorine.

nodes.name: Faecium
nodes.blurb: Creature drop. The old name is Coprite. Oxygen multiplies a stock. Mordite breaks down into it. Lubricant takes fifty.

nodes.name: Mordite
nodes.blurb: Harvested from creatures and from mordite root. Three units break down into one faecium.

nodes.name: Dioxite
nodes.blurb: Frozen-world earth. Frost crystal and salt titrate into it. It grows frost crystal back.

nodes.name: Phosphorus
nodes.blurb: Scorched-world earth. Solanium and salt titrate into it.

nodes.name: Uranium
nodes.blurb: Irradiated-world earth. Gamma root and salt titrate into it.

nodes.name: Ammonia
nodes.blurb: Toxic-world earth. Fungal mould and salt titrate into it.

nodes.name: Pyrite
nodes.blurb: Desert earth. Cactus flesh and salt titrate into it.

nodes.name: Silicate Powder
nodes.blurb: Dust from the terrain manipulator. Forty forge into one glass.

nodes.name: Glass
nodes.blurb: Forty frost crystal, from the blueprint or the refiner. Silicate powder forges it too.

nodes.name: Lubricant
nodes.blurb: Fifty faecium and four hundred gamma root. Living glass takes one.

nodes.name: Heat Capacitor
nodes.blurb: One hundred frost crystal and two hundred solanium. Half of a circuit board.

nodes.name: Poly Fibre
nodes.blurb: One hundred cactus flesh and two hundred star bulb. The other half of a circuit board.

nodes.name: Circuit Board
nodes.blurb: One heat capacitor and one poly fibre. Wiring loom is not in this recipe.

nodes.name: Living Glass
nodes.blurb: One lubricant and five glass.

nodes.name: Nitrogen Salt
nodes.blurb: High-speed sublimation: 100 nitrogen, 10 condensed carbon, and 5 chlorine.

nodes.name: Enriched Carbon
nodes.blurb: High-speed sublimation: 100 radon, 10 condensed carbon, and 5 chlorine.

nodes.name: Thermic Condensate
nodes.blurb: High-speed sublimation: 100 sulphurine, 10 condensed carbon, and 5 chlorine.

nodes.name: Unstable Plasma
nodes.blurb: Fifty oxygen and one metal plating. Launcher fuel. Charging the launcher is not a separate recipe here.

nodes.name: Aronium
nodes.blurb: A lightweight and highly malleable alloy.

nodes.name: Dirty Bronze
nodes.blurb: A popular metal alloy with a wide variety of uses.

nodes.name: Herox
nodes.blurb: Combined neutral alloy with uses that range from pharmacology all the way to heavy industry.

nodes.name: Lemmium
nodes.blurb: Pure Ferrite alloy.

nodes.name: Magno-Gold
nodes.blurb: Highly prized and lustrous alloy.

nodes.name: Grantine
nodes.blurb: Soft workable alloy favoured by artisans throughout the known galaxy.

nodes.name: Geodesite
nodes.blurb: Advanced and durable alloy primarily used in starship hull construction and deep-space exploration drone technology.

nodes.name: Iridesite
nodes.blurb: Advanced light metal alloy traded throughout the galactic Outer Edge.

nodes.name: Silver
nodes.blurb: Valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically mined from asteroids.

nodes.name: Gold
nodes.blurb: Highly valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically mined from asteroids.

nodes.name: Organic Catalyst
nodes.blurb: A catalytic material used in the creation of many organic fertilisers.

nodes.name: Semiconductor
nodes.blurb: An advanced material useful in many electronic devices, with its own in-built temperature regulator.

nodes.name: Hot Ice
nodes.blurb: A paradoxical material, made less mysterious by its relative ease of manufacture.

nodes.name: Fusion Accelerant
nodes.blurb: An advanced fuel source, made from a perfect blend of high potential energy organic materials.

nodes.name: Superconductor
nodes.blurb: An advanced conductive material, the superconductor further enriches the field-warping power of the Semiconductor.

nodes.name: Cryo-Pump
nodes.blurb: An advanced, self-regulating hybrid material, the Cryo-Pump distributes heat across itself with near perfect efficiency, making it vital in the creation of thermal regulators.

nodes.name: Quantum Computer
nodes.blurb: An extremely fast advanced processing unit.

nodes.name: Acid
nodes.blurb: Dilute acid for high current generation in diverse power cells.

nodes.name: Unstable Gel
nodes.blurb: A highly reactive gel, this substance is both energy-rich and dangerous to touch.

nodes.name: Liquid Explosive
nodes.blurb: A general purpose high explosive, offered in liquid form for convenience of transport and deployment.

nodes.name: Frigate Fuel (100 Tonnes)
nodes.blurb: A large barrel of frigate fuel.

nodes.name: Explosive Drones
nodes.blurb: A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

nodes.name: Holographic Analyser
nodes.blurb: A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

nodes.name: Mineral Compressor
nodes.blurb: A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

nodes.name: Fuel Oxidiser
nodes.blurb: A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

nodes.name: Mind Control Device
nodes.blurb: A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition.

nodes.name: Hydraulic Wiring
nodes.blurb: Specialist wiring and control threads, this flexible material allows the transmission of power and signals, as well as offering direct manipulation of remote components.

nodes.name: Portable Reactor
nodes.blurb: A miniature self-controlled nuclear reactor.

nodes.name: Quantum Processor
nodes.blurb: A highly advanced computational device, essential for the complex calculations involved in warp travel.

nodes.name: Cryogenic Chamber
nodes.blurb: A low temperature chamber, designed to prevent the natural decay of organic matter.

nodes.name: Solar Mirror
nodes.blurb: A specialist optical component.

nodes.name: Quad Servo
nodes.blurb: A highly sprung motor arm salvaged from inside of a Sentinel patrol unit.

nodes.name: Starshield Battery
nodes.blurb: A power storage unit optimised for use in starship defensive systems.

nodes.name: Fusion Ignitor
nodes.blurb: A highly advanced piece of technology for use in the next generation of power plants.

nodes.name: Stasis Device
nodes.blurb: A device specifically crafted to keep lifeforms alive for thousands of years longer than their natural lifespan.

nodes.name: Walker Brain
nodes.blurb: Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch.
